description.value: Tantalus View Retreat is a hand-crafted, off-grid chalet built entirely by log artisan Warren Brubacher, perched alone on a rock bluff above Swift Creek with a panorama of the Tantalus Mountain Range and glaciers. Sitting between Vancouver and Whistler, it runs on renewable energy and offers a private hot tub, creekside sauna, and cold plunge tub in a single-unit rental designed as a secluded nature sanctuary. Mountain biking is cited among the many adventure options within half an hour, though the chalet is reached via a luggage cable tram up the bluff from a Forest Service Road.

address.value: 451 Swift Creek Forest Service Road, Squamish

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Tantalus View Retreat is a single off-grid vacation rental chalet on a rock bluff accessed by a cable tram, with no mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. OSM's internet_access=no tag aligns with the website's repeated 'off-the-grid, no public utilities' framing. Contact details (phone (604) 848-9070, email tantalusretreat@gmail.com, address 451 Swift Creek Forest Service Road, Squamish) match exactly between OSM and the website.
concerns: Chalet is accessed by a luggage cable tram up a rock bluff — it is unclear how cyclists would bring bikes to or from the property.
Property sits on Swift Creek Forest Service Road; road surface and suitability for touring cyclists is unknown.
No cycling amenities (secure storage, tools, wash station, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
Off-grid operation confirmed by website; OSM internet_access=no consistent with this — Wi-Fi unlikely but not explicitly denied.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Located on the Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor with mountain biking nearby, but no cycling-specific amenities are evidenced; the cable-tram-only access to a rock bluff on a Forest Service Road raises serious practical concerns for cyclists arriving with loaded bikes or e-bikes.
